## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation
Why would this feature be useful? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen. How should this feature work?

### Example Usage
Show how the feature would be used:

```latex
\NewCommand{notebook.ipynb}{tag}
```

or

```json
{
  "cell": {
    "metadata": {
      "your_feature": "example"
    }
  }
}
```

## Alternatives Considered
Have you considered any alternative solutions or features? Describe them here.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## Implementation Ideas
If you have thoughts on how this could be implemented, please share them (optional).
